# Forms, submissions and members

Forms collect submissions; members are the site's signed-in visitors with roles that gate content (`visibleTo`).

[`form.list`](#formlist) · [`form.read`](#formread) · [`form.create`](#formcreate) · [`form.update`](#formupdate) · [`form.delete`](#formdelete) · [`submission.list`](#submissionlist) · [`submission.setStatus`](#submissionsetstatus) · [`submission.delete`](#submissiondelete) · [`member.list`](#memberlist) · [`member.invite`](#memberinvite) · [`member.setStatus`](#membersetstatus) · [`member.setRoles`](#membersetroles) · [`member.delete`](#memberdelete) · [`member.signOutAll`](#membersignoutall) · [`memberRole.list`](#memberrolelist) · [`memberRole.create`](#memberrolecreate) · [`memberRole.delete`](#memberroledelete) · [`form.sendTest`](#formsendtest)

## form.list

List the forms of the site with their fields and settings. Forms are not versioned: a saved definition takes effect at once.

- permission `site.read` (admin, editor); class `read`; writes nothing.
- Input: `{}`.

Example input:

```json
{}
```

## form.create

Create a form with its fields and settings. The key is unique on the site and never changes; a ds.form node names the form by its id. Forms are not versioned: a saved definition takes effect at once.

- permission `site.edit` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `forms`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `form` | object | yes |
| `form.key` | string (max 40) | yes |
| `form.label` | string (min 1, max 120) \| Record<locale, string (min 1, max 120)> | yes |
| `form.fields` | ({ key: string, type: "text" \| "email" \| "tel" \| "textarea" \| "select" \| "checkbox" \| "date", label: string (min 1, max 120) \| Record<locale, string (min 1, max 120)>, help?: string (min 1, max 240) \| Record<locale, string (min 1, max 240)>, placeholder?: string (min 1, max 120) \| Record<locale, string (min 1, max 120)… (full schema: discover_operations) | yes |
| `form.settings` | { recipients?: string[] (≤10), senderName?: string (min 1, max 80), replyToField?: string, consent?: boolean, honeypot?: boolean, minFillMs?: integer ≥0 ≤60000, open?: boolean, action?: { kind: "inbox" } \| { kind: "accessRequest", fields: { name: string, email: string, studio?: string, website?: string, message?: strin… (full schema: discover_operations) |  |

Output: { form: { id: uuid, key: string (max 40), label: string (min 1, max 120) \| Record<locale, string (min 1, max 120)>, fields: ({ key: string, type: "text" \| "email" \| "tel" \| "textarea" \| "select" \| "checkbox" \| "date", label: string (min 1, max 120) \| Record<locale, …>, help?: string (min 1, max 240) \| Record<locale, …>… (full schema: discover_operations)

Example input:

```json
{"form":{"key":"contact","label":{"it":"Contatti","en":"Contact"},"fields":[{"key":"name","type":"text","label":{"it":"Nome","en":"Name"},"required":true,"maxLength":120},{"key":"email","type":"email","label":"Email","required":true},{"key":"topic","type":"select","label":{"it":"Argomento","en":"Topic"},"options":[{"value":"visit","label":{"it":"Visita","en":"Visit"}},{"value":"press","label":{"it":"Stampa","en":"Press"}}]},{"key":"message","type":"textarea","label":{"it":"Messaggio","en":"Message"},"required":true,"maxLength":2000}],"settings":{"recipients":["info@example.com"],"senderName":"Sito web","replyToField":"email","consent":true}}}
```

## form.update

Patch the label, fields or settings of a form. The change is live at once: the public form follows without a publish, and stored submissions keep the values they were sent with. Forms are not versioned: a saved definition takes effect at once.

- permission `site.edit` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `form:{formId}`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `formId` | uuid | yes |
| `patch` | object | yes |
| `patch.label` | string (min 1, max 120) \| Record<locale, string (min 1, max 120)> |  |
| `patch.fields` | ({ key: string, type: "text" \| "email" \| "tel" \| "textarea" \| "select" \| "checkbox" \| "date", label: string (min 1, max 120) \| Record<locale, string (min 1, max 120)>, help?: string (min 1, max 240) \| Record<locale, string (min 1, max 240)>, placeholder?: string (min 1, max 120) \| Record<locale, string (min 1, max 120)… (full schema: discover_operations) |  |
| `patch.settings` | { recipients?: string[] (≤10), senderName?: string (min 1, max 80), replyToField?: string, consent?: boolean, honeypot?: boolean, minFillMs?: integer ≥0 ≤60000, open?: boolean, action?: { kind: "inbox" } \| { kind: "accessRequest", fields: { name: string, email: string, studio?: string, website?: string, message?: strin… (full schema: discover_operations) |  |

Output: { form: { id: uuid, key: string (max 40), label: string (min 1, max 120) \| Record<locale, string (min 1, max 120)>, fields: ({ key: string, type: "text" \| "email" \| "tel" \| "textarea" \| "select" \| "checkbox" \| "date", label: string (min 1, max 120) \| Record<locale, …>, help?: string (min 1, max 240) \| Record<locale, …>… (full schema: discover_operations)

Example input:

```json
{"formId":"d4e5f6a7-b8c9-4d0e-9f1a-3b4c5d6e7f8a","patch":{"settings":{"recipients":["info@example.com","press@example.com"],"senderName":"Sito web","replyToField":"email","consent":true}}}
```

## form.delete

Delete a form and every submission it received. A ds.form node that names it then draws its error state. Forms are not versioned: a saved definition takes effect at once.

- permission `site.edit` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `forms`, `form:{formId}`, `submissions:{formId}`; needs `"confirmed": ["destructive"]`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `formId` | uuid | yes |

Output: { success: true }

Example input:

```json
{"formId":"d4e5f6a7-b8c9-4d0e-9f1a-3b4c5d6e7f8a"}
```

## submission.setStatus

Mark submissions of a form new, read or archived. Forms are not versioned: a saved definition takes effect at once.

- permission `content.edit` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `submissions:{formId}`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `formId` | uuid | yes |
| `submissionIds` | uuid[] (≤200) | yes |
| `status` | "new" \| "read" \| "archived" | yes |

Output: { formId: uuid, updated: integer ≥0 }

Example input:

```json

```

## member.list

List the members of the site, newest first, with their status and role keys, optionally only those with a status or matching a query on the email or name, a page at a time. Members are not versioned: a change takes effect at once.

- permission `members.manage` (admin, editor); class `read`; writes nothing.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | "pending" \| "active" \| "disabled" |  |
| `query` | string (min 1, max 120) |  |
| `offset` | integer ≥0 |  |
| `limit` | integer ≥1 ≤200 |  |

Output: { members: ({ id: uuid, email: string, name: string, status: "pending" \| "active" \| "disabled", roles: string (max 40)[], emailVerifiedAt: string \| null, lastLoginAt: string \| null, createdAt: string })[], total: integer ≥0 }

Example input:

```json
{"status":"active","limit":20}
```

## member.invite

Invite a person by email: a pending member with the given roles, and an email with a one-use link to the site's reset page where they set a password. Inviting a pending member again sends a fresh link; an active or disabled member is refused. Members are not versioned: a change takes effect at once.

- permission `members.manage` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `members`; **not undoable**: alone in its batch.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `email` | string | yes |
| `name` | string (min 1, max 120) | yes |
| `roles` | string (max 40)[] (≤50) |  |
| `locale` | "it" \| "en" |  |

Output: { member: { id: uuid, email: string, name: string, status: "pending" \| "active" \| "disabled", roles: string (max 40)[], emailVerifiedAt: string \| null, lastLoginAt: string \| null, createdAt: string } }

Example input:

```json
{"email":"giulia@example.com","name":"Giulia Bianchi","roles":["press"],"locale":"it"}
```

## member.setStatus

Enable or disable a member. Disabling signs the member out everywhere at once. Members are not versioned: a change takes effect at once.

- permission `members.manage` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `members`; **not undoable**: alone in its batch.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `memberId` | uuid | yes |
| `status` | "active" \| "disabled" | yes |

Output: { member: { id: uuid, email: string, name: string, status: "pending" \| "active" \| "disabled", roles: string (max 40)[], emailVerifiedAt: string \| null, lastLoginAt: string \| null, createdAt: string } }

Example input:

```json
{"memberId":"0a1b2c3d-4e5f-4a6b-8c7d-9e0f1a2b3c4d","status":"disabled"}
```

## member.setRoles

Replace the roles a member holds with the given role keys, each a role of the site's catalogue. Members are not versioned: a change takes effect at once.

- permission `members.manage` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `members`; **not undoable**: alone in its batch.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `memberId` | uuid | yes |
| `roles` | string (max 40)[] (≤50) | yes |

Output: { member: { id: uuid, email: string, name: string, status: "pending" \| "active" \| "disabled", roles: string (max 40)[], emailVerifiedAt: string \| null, lastLoginAt: string \| null, createdAt: string } }

Example input:

```json
{"memberId":"0a1b2c3d-4e5f-4a6b-8c7d-9e0f1a2b3c4d","roles":["press","board"]}
```

## member.delete

Delete a member with their sessions and roles. Run it with `confirmed: ["destructive"]`. Members are not versioned: a change takes effect at once.

- permission `members.manage` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `members`; needs `"confirmed": ["destructive"]`; **not undoable**: alone in its batch.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `memberId` | uuid | yes |

Output: { success: true }

Example input:

```json
{"memberId":"0a1b2c3d-4e5f-4a6b-8c7d-9e0f1a2b3c4d"}
```

## member.signOutAll

Sign out every member of the site at once: the site's member cookies get a new key, so every cookie issued before stops working, and every session of the site is deleted. Members keep their accounts and sign in again. Other sites are not affected. Run it with `confirmed: ["destructive"]`. Members are not versioned: a change takes effect at once.

- permission `site.admin` (admin); class `transaction`; writes `members`; needs `"confirmed": ["destructive"]`; **not undoable**: alone in its batch.
- Input: `{}`.

Output: { sessions: integer ≥0 }

Example input:

```json
{}
```

## memberRole.list

List the site's member roles with their labels and how many members hold each. A node gated to members names roles by key. Members are not versioned: a change takes effect at once.

- permission `members.manage` (admin, editor); class `read`; writes nothing.
- Input: `{}`.

Output: { roles: ({ key: string (max 40), label: string (min 1, max 60) \| Record<locale, string (min 1, max 60)>, memberCount: integer ≥0, requiredBy: { pages: integer ≥0, articles: integer ≥0 } })[] }

Example input:

```json
{}
```

## memberRole.create

Add a role to the site's catalogue. The key is unique on the site and never changes. Members are not versioned: a change takes effect at once.

- permission `members.manage` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `memberRoles`; **not undoable**: alone in its batch.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `key` | string (max 40) | yes |
| `label` | string (min 1, max 60) \| Record<locale, string (min 1, max 60)> | yes |

Output: { role: { key: string (max 40), label: string (min 1, max 60) \| Record<locale, string (min 1, max 60)>, memberCount: integer ≥0, requiredBy: { pages: integer ≥0, articles: integer ≥0 } } }

Example input:

```json
{"key":"press","label":{"it":"Stampa","en":"Press"}}
```

## memberRole.delete

Delete a role: every member who held it loses it, and it is taken off the `requiredRoles` of every draft page and article that named it (the answer counts them in `stripped`; `memberRole.list` counts them beforehand in `requiredBy`). A node gated to that role alone shows to no member. Undoable: the undo brings back the role, its assignments and the `requiredRoles`. Run it with `confirmed: ["destructive"]`. Members are not versioned: a change takes effect at once.

- permission `members.manage` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `memberRoles`, `pages`; needs `"confirmed": ["destructive"]`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `key` | string (max 40) | yes |

Output: { success: true, stripped: { pages: integer ≥0, articles: integer ≥0 } }

Example input:

```json
{"key":"press"}
```

## form.sendTest

Render the notification a submission of the form sends, with sample values for its fields. With `dryRun` (the default) the message is answered unsent; without it, it is sent to the form's recipients through the platform mail transport. Run it alone in a batch.

- permission `site.edit` (admin, editor); class `external`; writes nothing; external: alone in its batch, never in a dry run.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `formId` | uuid | yes |
| `dryRun` | boolean |  |

Output: { formId: uuid, dryRun: boolean, message: { to: string[], fromName?: string, replyTo?: string, subject: string (min 1), text: string, html?: string }, messageId: string \| null }

Example input:

```json
{"formId":"d4e5f6a7-b8c9-4d0e-9f1a-3b4c5d6e7f8a","dryRun":true}
```
